note: Ghana: nationals of the ECOWAS states, Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger enter without a visa; nationals of the African Union's other states, the Caribbean states listed and Singapore need a free Electronic Travel Authorization (90 days); everyone else applies for an e-Visa (since 25 May 2026; USD 260 single entry). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Ghana
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries can visit Ghana without a visa: All ECOWAS member states Burkina Faso Mali Niger ... Citizens of the following countries and territories are required to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization to enter Ghana, for a stay up to the duration listed below. The Electronic Travel Authorization is granted free of charge: 90 days All other African Union member states Antigua and Barbuda Bahamas Barbados Dominica Grenada Guyana Jamaica Saint Lucia Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Singapore Trinidad and Tobago ... Ghana has brought online the official portal that will be used for electronic visa applications starting May 25, 2026.
